en.t: ... What was strange was what happened after that.

units.source_text: 因为经过一番惨不忍睹的过程之后，它在我的眼里终于渐渐地变成很美的东西。

en.t: For after passing through a process too cruel to bear looking at, it finally, little by little, became something very beautiful in my eyes.

units.source_text: 美的无结果、无快感的性质赋予了它。

en.t: The fruitless, pleasureless nature of beauty had been bestowed upon it.

units.source_text: 乳房尽管呈现在我的眼前，但它却渐渐地被闭锁在自身的原理的内面，

en.t: Although the breast appeared before my eyes, it was gradually being shut away within the inner side of its own principle,

units.source_text: 如同蔷薇闭锁在蔷薇的原理的内面一样。

en.t: just as a rose is shut away within the inner side of the principle of the rose.
